extracted.name: Creamy Potato Casserole
extracted.description: This cheesy hash brown casserole combines frozen hash browns, Cheddar cheese, sour cream, and cream of potato soup for an easy, crowd-pleasing side dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of potato soup
1 (2 pound) package frozen hash brown potatoes
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Heat sour cream, condensed soup, and butter in a small pot over low heat.
Combine potatoes, 1 cup cheese, and green onions in a large mixing bowl. Mix in heated soup mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Pour into a 9x13-inch dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve warm.
